subject: Rivermark CAIQ intake: scheduling, evidence owners, and clarifications
messages:
From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@rivermark.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Leo Martinez <leo.martinez@rivermark.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake & kickoff - Rivermark / Redwood

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We're starting our security intake for possible production usage of Redwood Inference and would like to schedule a CAIQ/SIG walkthrough + intake call next week. High-level asks from our side: 

- A short (30–45m) walkthrough of your CAIQ answers and where supporting evidence lives.
- Confirmation of log retention options and whether sample logs can be delivered (redacted).
- Clarify encryption-at-rest and key management (KMS/HSM) approach for private deployments.
- A point of contact for procurement to scope commercial/contractual items after the intake.

Can you share a few available slots next week (PST)? Also, I attached our intake sheet with a few highlighted questions to prioritize.

Thanks,
Anita Shah
Security Manager
Rivermark Financial

Attachments: Rivermark_CAIC_Questions_20270528.pdf (PDF, 412KB)
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@rivermark.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake & kickoff - Rivermark / Redwood

Hi Anita —

Appreciate the note and the intake sheet. We're available next week and can definitely run a CAIQ walkthrough and agree on evidence handoff expectations. Proposed slots (PST):

- Tue 2027-05-31 09:00–09:45
- Tue 2027-05-31 13:00–13:45
- Wed 2027-06-01 11:00–11:45

Internal owners I've cc'd and their areas:
- Marissa Cole — SOC 2 artifacts, policies, and control mappings
- David Kim — logging architecture, sample export, and retention options
- Hannah Schmitt — network and infra diagrams, CAIQ mapping notes

I've attached a short preflight checklist and a trimmed CAIQ template that shows where we expect to place evidence artifacts. For the call it would be helpful if you can share (beforehand) the subset of questions you want to prioritize and any required format for artifacts (e.g., PDFs, ZIPs of logs).

Attachments: Redwood_CAIC_Preflight_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 38KB)

Best,
Monica
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

--

> Hi Monica,
> 
> Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We're starting our security intake for possible production usage of Redwood Inference and would like to schedule a CAIQ/SIG walkthrough + intake call next week...
From: Anita Shah <anita.shah@rivermark.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Leo Martinez <leo.martinez@rivermark.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake & kickoff - Rivermark / Redwood

Monica —

Thanks, Tue 2027-05-31 13:00 PST works for us. A couple of clarifications ahead of the call: 

1) For logs: we need to confirm if Redwood can provide a 7-day redacted sample export (gzip) that includes request/response latency, request id, model variant, and timestamps. Is that possible and what anonymization do you apply by default?
2) For key management: we operate in multiple regions; can you outline if customers can bring their own keys (BYOK) in the Private deployment option and whether HSM-backed KMS is supported?
3) Procurement: looping in our procurement team (procurements@rivermark.com) to capture contract timing.

Also, can you confirm whether the CAIQ evidence package will be delivered as a single ZIP or via shared Drive? Ideally we want a Drive link for easier review and redaction.

See you on Tue.

-Anita

--
Anita Shah
Security Manager, Rivermark Financial
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Anita Shah <anita.shah@rivermark.com>, Leo Martinez <leo.martinez@rivermark.com>, procurements@rivermark.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 13:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Rivermark CAIQ intake — meeting notes & action items (Tue 2027-05-31 13:00 PST)

Hi Anita / Leo / procurement team —

Thanks for a productive call today. Notes and agreed actions below.

Summary:
- Walkthrough covered CAIQ sections we flagged in your intake sheet. We identified 6 high-priority questions around logging, key management, and data residency.
- Agreed that Redwood will provide a curated evidence bundle (Drive folder) containing policy PDFs, control mapping sheet, and a redacted 7-day log sample.
- Procurement indicated an initial procurement window of ~3 weeks once legal has the SOW.

Action items (owners & ETA):
1) Redwood to share Drive folder with curated artifacts (policy PDFs, SOC 2 excerpts, CAIQ mapping) — Owner: Marissa Cole — ETA: 2027-06-03 EOD.
2) Redacted 7-day log sample (gzip) with fields: request_id, model_variant, latency_ms, timestamp — Owner: David Kim — ETA: 2027-06-04. Notes: we will redact PII and mask prompts per our privacy guidelines.
3) BYOK/HSM technical note: short doc describing Private deployment KMS options and supported HSM vendors — Owner: Hannah Schmitt — ETA: 2027-06-02.
4) Procurement SOW template & cost estimates for Dedicated/Private options — Owner: Monica Patel — ETA: 2027-06-07 (will follow up with commercial).

Attachments shared during call: infra-diagram-2027-05.png (PNG), Redwood_CAIC_Preflight_Checklist.xlsx (XLSX).

Temporary links (we'll move to the canonical Drive folder above):
- https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aRivermark-CAIQ-Intake (Redwood private folder — view only for Rivermark)

If any item above needs adjusting, flag it and we'll update. We'll send the Drive invite once Marissa drops the artifacts in.

Best,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

--
